items.description: Close Phase 10 WR-07 (USER DECIDED: honor max_lines alone): in src/sif/mcp/backend.py get_document (~line 211), line slicing currently runs only under `if from_line is not None:` so a client sending only max_lines gets the full document. Change the guard to `if from_line is not None or max_lines is not None:` and default the start to line 1 when from_line is absent (start = max(0, (from_line or 1) - 1); end = len(lines) if max_lines is None else start + max_lines), preserving the existing line_start/line_end metadata and the _truncate_content call. The tool schema (handlers.py) and docs/mcp-server.md already declare the two params independent — no schema change needed. Add regression tests in tests/unit/mcp/test_backend.py: max_lines alone slices from line 1; from_line alone unchanged; both together unchanged; neither returns full content (TDD: non-vacuous RED first — max_lines-alone currently returns full content). Then close WR-07 in .planning/milestones/v1.0-phases/10-raise-pytest-coverage-to-90/10-REVIEW-DISPOSITION.md (exactly 3 edits: YAML disposition open->fixed, open count read from execution-time git show HEAD:<ledger> and decremented by 1 dynamically, markdown row Disposition fixed + Source cell naming this quick task and the user decision; byte-equality reconstruction gate vs execution-time HEAD; NO **Status:** resolved lines in this ledger)

Close Phase 10 WR-08 (USER DECIDED: degrade to BM25-only at the MCP boundary): in src/sif/mcp/backend.py hybrid_search, SearchPipeline->HybridSearcher->VectorSearcher is constructed per request and VectorSearcher.__init__ raises RuntimeError when the sqlite-vec extension is missing, so every MCP query fails while CLI BM25 works. Catch the missing-extension failure in hybrid_search's _search and fall back to a direct BM25Searcher (log a warning ONCE, mirroring the __init__ embedder-failure posture at backend.py:106-107). Do NOT change the core HybridSearcher.search fail-fast behavior in src/sif/search/hybrid.py — the degradation is an MCP-boundary decision only. UPDATE CLAUDE.md "Error Handling Conventions" to record the carve-out: the MCP SearchBackend boundary degrades to BM25-only (one-time warning) when sqlite-vec is unavailable, consistent with its existing embedder-failure degradation, while the core HybridSearcher.search remains fail-fast (this CLAUDE.md edit is explicitly user-authorized). Add regression tests in tests/unit/mcp/test_backend.py proving that when VectorSearcher construction raises RuntimeError (sqlite-vec missing), hybrid_search returns BM25 results instead of raising, and that the warning is emitted once (TDD: non-vacuous RED first). Then close WR-08 in 10-REVIEW-DISPOSITION.md (exactly 3 edits: YAML, open count read from execution-time git show HEAD:<ledger> and decremented by 1 dynamically, markdown row with Source cell naming this quick task and the user decision; byte-equality reconstruction gate; NO **Status:** resolved lines)

Close Phase 10 IN-05 (USER DECIDED: remove the no-op --config option): the global --config/-c option in src/sif/cli/main.py (~lines 54-60, stored at :79 as ctx.obj['config_path']) is accepted and documented but never consumed — configuration comes from SIF_ env vars / Pydantic Settings. Remove the @click.option('--config','-c',...) decorator, the `config: str` parameter from the cli() signature, and the ctx.obj['config_path'] assignment (and the DEFAULT_CONFIG_PATH import if it becomes unused). Find and update any tests that pass -c/--config or assert on config_path. REGENERATE docs/cli-reference.md via `make docs-generate` (it is generator-owned — NEVER hand-edit; a CI diff gate enforces this); do not touch docs/configuration.md unless the generator changes it. Verify the regenerated reference no longer lists --config. Then close IN-05 in 10-REVIEW-DISPOSITION.md (exactly 3 edits: YAML, open count read from execution-time git show HEAD:<ledger> and decremented by 1 dynamically, markdown row with Source cell naming this quick task and the user decision; byte-equality reconstruction gate; NO **Status:** resolved lines)

Close Phase 10 IN-07 (embedding-dim resolution consistency, medium refactor): two sites resolve embedding_dim inconsistently. (1) src/sif/cli/commands/search.py query_cmd (~line 898) pays `embedding_dim = len(manager.embed_single("probe"))` on every invocation — a billed API call for remote backends. (2) src/sif/cli/commands/bench.py _load_embedder (~line 105) falls back to a magic `embedding_dim = 384` (settings default is 1024) and also probes at :109. Fix: prefer the probe-free `manager.get_model_info().get("embedding_dim")` (reads the loaded model's dimension property, no API call — the same approach embed_cmd at index.py was deliberately given) with the embed_single probe only as a fallback when get_model_info yields no dim; in bench_cmd drop the 384 literal (it is only reachable when the embedder is None and the value is unused by BM25-only search — use settings.embedding_dim as the neutral default instead). Consider a single shared resolution helper if it reduces duplication without over-engineering. Add/adjust regression tests proving query_cmd no longer calls embed_single when get_model_info provides the dim, and bench no longer references 384 (TDD: non-vacuous RED first). Then close IN-07 in 10-REVIEW-DISPOSITION.md (exactly 3 edits: YAML, open count read from execution-time git show HEAD:<ledger> and decremented by 1 dynamically, markdown row with Source cell naming this quick task; byte-equality reconstruction gate; NO **Status:** resolved lines)
